perStorey.aggregates: count(*) as Elements, count(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as ElementsWithValue, sum(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as Embodied, avg(EnergyUseIntensity_kWh_per_m2_year) as MeanEui

about.text: Q8: embodied carbon A1-A3 summed per storey. Elements is every element on the storey; ElementsWithValue is how many of them have an embodied-carbon row (Q7). On Roof, 7 of 8 elements have a value; the roof itself has none, so its sum (Embodied) covers only those 7.
